sources.title: facebook/mms-tts-tmc · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model is part of Facebook's Massively Multilingual Speech project, aiming to provide speech technology across a diverse range of languages. You can find more details about the supported languages and their ISO 639-3 codes in the MMS Language Coverage Overview, and see all MMS-TTS checkpoints on the Hugging Face Hub: facebook/mms-tts.
